visualCharacteristics.purpose: Story cards in a horizontal scroll-snap carousel with prev/next arrows
visualCharacteristics.layout: Edge-to-edge scroll-snap track; the active story is centred (85% wide on mobile, 506px from 900px, 694px from 1200px) with neighbours peeking; only the active story shows its text
visualCharacteristics.interactions: Prev/next arrows (900px+) move one story and disable at the ends; native swipe/scroll; wide screens open on the second story

contentPattern.structure: one row per story: cell 1 = image; cell 2 = title (H3, ideally linked), teaser paragraph, date / read-time paragraph, CTA link (e.g. Read full story)
rows: H3 title, teaser, date | read time, CTA link

reuseGuidance: Use for article/story teasers in a carousel. The last plain paragraph (when there are at least two) is styled as the meta line. Optional page metadata carousel-previous-label / carousel-next-label localize the arrows.
